text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, I head to the classroom<n>searching for
Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ahem, here we go. "I think upon you,<n>as I—"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Outta the way, Spe! I GOT THIS!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El, that isn't even close to the correct<n>card. You
just earned yourself a<n>penalty.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh? I coulda sworn the poem went<n>like that.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. The academy is holding a<n>karuta
contest soon, so we're<n>practicing matching poetry
verses to<n>their continuations.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's right! Grass is really, really<n>good!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But, um... El is a little—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A little what?! It's not like you're any<n>better at this,
Spe!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
How are we supposed to remember<n>all these
so-called poems anyways?<n>They all just sound like
lazy run-on<n>sentences to me!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You couldn't be more mistaken, El.<n>Each one tells a
unique story. This<n>one, for instance...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I think upon you, as I take to the<n>springtide fields,
harvesting new<n>greens. The sleeve of my robe
collects its own share of falling snow.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It paints a scene of someone<n>gathering fresh
greens for the one<n>they love as winter fades into
spring.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There's something beautiful about<n>how it depicts
not the peak of spring,<n>but the subtle transition
between<n>seasons.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh... I never would've guessed. If<n>you ask me,
snow during springtime<n>sounds like a pain...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What's beautiful about pickin'<n>veggies? I mean I
could maaaybe see<n>it if they were red-hot peppers
or<n>something fun, but c'mon...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That would get you excited,wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Still, what I want to say is: visualizing<n>what the
poem depicts can make<n>memorizing it easier.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah! You might be right! You're<n>amazing, Grass!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
All right, Grass! Do another round! I'll<n>snag the right
card for sure this time!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Very well.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know. This game is more fun<n>with more
players. Would you care to<n>join us, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I'll take you up on that.

I'll take over as game master so you can play,
Grass.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Great. I'll continue as the reader,<n>then.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I hope you're good at this, Grass's<n>Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Bet ya can't flip the cards<n>faster than me
though!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, I join them all playing the<n>verse-matching
card game.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. This one is absolutely<n>exquisite, so please
try to visualize<n>the story as you listen.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It portrays the traditional Japanese<n>appreciation for
fleeting beauty,<n>illustrated in the contrast between—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Graaass! It's awesome that you<n>know so much,
but...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
This is gonna take forever if ya keep<n>explainin'
each one before we start!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The game lasts longer than everyone<n>had intended,
but Grass Wonder is<n>beaming with joy the entire
time.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good idea! After all that practice,<n>we might be
able to put up a fight<n>against Grass!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Uh, S-Spe?! You probably don't<n>wanna go saying
things like—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well, isn't that an idea? Thank you,<n>Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And of course, I'm sure nobody will<n>mind if I give
this my all. ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Why does her smile look so scary?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the poem-matching<n>card game
recommences.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There—it seems like I've won. El, you<n>didn't even
manage to claim a single<n>card.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
NGGGHHH! One more round! We're<n>doin' this
again!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I knew Grass was gonna be good,but this good? I don't think anyonecould beat her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The way Grass Wonder dominated<n>this practice
session, she should be<n>unstoppable in the contest.
